mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns; a higher rate increases the discount rate for equity cash flows, reducing valuations and leading to negative 20-day returns. This relationship holds continuously without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 200.0 indicates persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5.0%, the economy is in a tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction of these two series is necessary to activate the signal.
regime_hint: tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDPC1 growth above 2.0% annually), strong economic momentum supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust supply chain activity and strong economic output, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is positive because the current INDPRO is above its 2017 base level (100).
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting central bank tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts index (HOUST) above 1600 thousand units indicates robust residential construction, supporting consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is above 137000 thousand persons and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 110.0, the economy is in a strong growth regime with robust labor and supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction of these two series is necessary to activate the signal.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 137000.0 AND INDPRO > 110.0.
